fails_if: `_CheckedCodingEntry._checked_authority` stops refusing a `[[coding.choice]]` that carries both a compact `expected_evidence_sha256` and a row-level `source_authority`, so the entry loads with two guard forms
note: The authority is otherwise complete (its records were rendered once from the shared `scb-value` spec through the build-case `expected_records` placeholder); its fingerprints are dummy hex because the exclusivity check runs before any comparison with the source. The allowed twin of each guard form loads alone: the digest-only choices of the build cases (coding-choice-applies-kept-list-to-every-period) and the authority-only `coding-documented-own-certificate-loads`.

message_contains: coding evidence digest and source authority are exclusive
